title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Maria Hart
content:
SOC2 prep scratchpad - Maria

Context / goal:
- Personal working notes for mapping Redwood Inference controls to SOC 2 trust services criteria (Security primarily; note Availability & Confidentiality overlaps).
- Use to prep evidence list, owners, and open gaps for the upcoming readiness review (internal) and audit kickoff.

Meeting notes (2026-02-10 sync with Lena, Priya, Ryan):
- Covered CC: Security scoping and evidence buckets.
- Action: finalize minimum evidence list for each control family by 2026-02-20.
- Follow-up: Ryan to share S3 access logs query example; Priya to pull encryption key rotation docs.

High-level mapping (first pass) - rough, needs refinement:
- TSC: Security (primary)
  - Logical access (user mgmt / SSO) -> evidence: Okta org config export, onboarding/offboarding playbook, sample HR termination ticket
    - owner: Priya K.
    - status: partial (have playbook, missing sample ticket export)
  - System/config change mgmt -> evidence: GitHub protected branch rules, PR review policy, infrastructure-as-code PRs (Terraform state), change request logs (JIRA)
    - owner: DevOps / Release Eng (TBD) -> ask Alex or Casey
    - gap: need a dated list of production config changes and approvers for audit window
  - Vulnerability mgmt -> evidence: weekly vuln scan reports, patching policy, exception list; why: show cadence and remediation SLAs
    - owner: eng-security (Lena)
    - gap: track of patch timelines for all infra images (some hosts are managed by cloud providers)
  - Monitoring/alerting & incident response -> evidence: PagerDuty rotation export, incident postmortems (redacted), runbook index
    - owner: SRE (SLO/monitoring team)
  - Data encryption (at-rest and in-transit) -> evidence: KMS policies, sample ciphertext metadata, TLS termination diagram
    - owner: infra/security

- TSC: Availability
  - Backups & DR -> evidence: backup configuration, restore test report (last 6 months), RTO/RPO docs
  - Capacity & scaling -> evidence: autoscaling policies, Dedicated capacity SLA docs (but need to ensure test evidence)

- TSC: Confidentiality
  - Data classification & handling -> evidence: DLP policy, data inventory export (partial), NDA template for contractors

Open risk questions to resolve (brain-dump):
- What is our canonical evidence for "timely termination"? HR tickets + deprovision logs enough? Need examples with timestamps to show within X days/hours.
- For model artifacts stored in S3, do we treat model weights as confidential? Who owns the classification and where is that logged?
- Are all third-party managed services covered by SOC evidence (e.g., cloud provider SOC reports)? We should collect SOC2/SOC3 links for major vendors (AWS, GitHub) and list them in vendor inventory.
- How to demonstrate continuous deployment controls when builds automatically deploy to staging/production with CI gating? We need policy + examples of approvals and recent PRs showing gating.

Quick evidence checklist (to collect):
- Okta org export (users, groups, SSO mappings) - Priya
- HR termination tickets and deprovision logs (redacted) - People Ops + IT
- Sample encrypted volume metadata + KMS policy - Infrastructure
- Weekly vulnerability scan exports (last 6 months) + remediation tracker - Eng Sec (Lena)
- Incident postmortems (3 recent, redacted) + PagerDuty rotation - SRE
- Backup configuration + last restore test report - infra/ops
- Change control: list of production changes + approvers (last 6 months) - Release Eng / DevOps
- Vendor SOC reports (AWS, Cloud DB, Github) - procurement/security

Evidence notes / tricky items:
- Some evidence lives in internal Confluence pages that are private; auditors will request exported PDFs. Need to ensure page history preserved.
- GH PRs: need to pick representative PRs where code changes went through reviews; include timestamps showing approvals before merge.
- For private deployments (customer/VPC packages), evidence may differ per customer instance — capture a template and note variance.

Immediate TODOs (next 10 days):
- [ ] Ask HR to export sample termination ticket + timestamped deprovision logs (due 2026-02-18) - assigned to Maria
- [ ] Get Okta org export and field mapping (due 2026-02-17) - Priya
- [ ] Pull vuln scan history and remediation SLAs for audit window (due 2026-02-20) - Lena
- [ ] Draft change control evidence list and reach out to Alex (Release Eng) for approver list (due 2026-02-19) - Maria
- [ ] Compile vendor SOC links and confirm coverage (due 2026-02-18) - Ryan

Notes to self (things to remember / questions to ask auditors):
- Confirm audit date window and whether rolling 12 months or calendar year. If different, we may need to adjust which evidence we pull.
- Ask auditor whether redacted postmortems are acceptable; prepare anonymization process.
- Clarify whether policy docs need formal version history or just latest signed version.

Draft control mapping snippet (format for final mapping doc) - simple table idea (we will create in Drive doc later):
- Control ID: SEC-01
- TSC: Security
- Control description: User provisioning and deprovisioning controls to prevent unauthorized access.
- Owner: Priya Kapoor
- Evidence: Okta export, HR ticket, deprovision logs
- Status: partial
- Gap / notes: missing consolidated deprovision log bundle for audit window

Random fragments / brainstorming (messy):
- Could use BigQuery export for auth logs rather than raw CloudTrail? easier queries for auditor. Verify retention window.
- Consider a short "SOC2 readiness" dashboard in Console to surface evidence status by control family (nice to have).
- For Dedicated customers, need a separate mapping doc showing per-customer evidence differences.

Meeting prep for 2026-02-17 internal readiness review:
- Bring list of missing artifacts and owners (checklist above).
- Have a table of "ask HR" and "ask Release Eng" ready so owners can action quickly.
- Build a timeline for audit kickoff and sample evidence delivery (zip + index).

References / links (to collect):
- Confluence SOC2 Playbook (draft) - will link here once finalized
- JIRA-SEC-128 (risk register)
- PR#4723 (example change control PR)

End notes: keep this doc very messy — it's my working scratchpad. When ready, port to shared Drive doc: shared_drives/security-and-compliance/soc2/control-mapping-draft.json

-- Maria
